header: Query metrics using the Monitoring API
content:
You can construct arbitrary queries over the Cloud NAT metrics by using the Monitoring API's
v3 projects.timeSeries.list request (/monitoring/api/ref_v3/rest/v3/projects.timeSeries/list).
API example
Getting allocated ports of a VM, with 1m aggregates, timeSeries.list
(/monitoring/api/ref_v3/rest/v3/projects.timeSeries/list) parameters:
name: projects/PROJECT_ID
Filter: resource.type = "gce_instance" AND
metric.name="compute.googleapis.com/nat/allocated_ports" AND
metric.labels.nat_gateway_name="nat-1-237227-1569344091-5"
interval.start_time: 2019-09-24T16:58:53Z
